components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default action button. Zinc surface background with inverse text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #18181b; color: #fafafa; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 6px; border: none; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; transition: opacity 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #18181b; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. Transparent background, text-only until hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #09090b; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 6px; border: none; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #f4f4f5; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #18181b; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Tertiary action. Paper background with border.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: #ffffff; color: #09090b; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #e4e4e7; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #f4f4f5; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #18181b; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Standard text input. Transparent background with zinc border.
components.css: .ds-input { background: transparent; color: #09090b; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #e4e4e7; font-size: 14px; height: 36px; width: 100%; transition: box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #71717a; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #18181b; } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Content container. Paper background with hairline border and subtle shadow.
components.html:
Crawl Results

Last updated 2 hours ago

Card content goes here.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; color: #09090b; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(228,228,231,0.6); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); } .ds-card-header { padding: 24px 24px 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-card-title { font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-card-desc { font-size: 14px; color: #71717a; } .ds-card-body { padding: 24px; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Compact status label. Primary background with inverse text.
components.css: .ds-badge { background: #18181b; color: #fafafa; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-badge:hover { background: rgba(24,24,27,0.8); }

components.name: Success Badge
components.description: Positive status indicator. Emerald tint background.

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Sidebar navigation link. Active state uses emphasis background with medium weight.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; color: #3f3f46; background: transparent; border: none; cursor: pointer; width: 100%; text-align: left; transition: background-color 200ms linear; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #e2e8f0; } .ds-nav-item[data-active="true"] { background: #e2e8f0; font-weight: 500; color: #18181b; } .ds-nav-kbd { margin-left: auto; font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Geist Mono', monospace; background: #f4f4f5; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; color: #71717a; }

components.name: Tabs List
components.description: Segmented control for switching between views. Muted background with active tab highlighted.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: inline-flex; background: #f4f4f5; border-radius: 8px; padding: 4px; height: 36px; align-items: center; gap: 4px; } .ds-tab { padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #71717a; background: transparent; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-tab[data-active="true"] { background: #ffffff; color: #09090b; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); } .ds-tab:hover:not([data-active="true"]) { color: #09090b; }

narrative.overview: OpenCited's visual system is built for developers who treat answer engine optimization as serious work, not a dashboard to glance at. The interface is a workspace: organized, dense without being cluttered, and quiet enough that the data speaks louder than the chrome. Every surface exists to reduce cognitive load, not add to it. The aesthetic is Steel and Paper — cool zinc neutrals, crisp contrast, editorial precision. There is no saturated accent color carrying the brand. The monochrome palette is the brand.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome zinc palette with no decorative color
Flat surfaces separated by hairline borders, not shadows
Geist typeface family: clean, geometric, technical
Keyboard-first interaction patterns with visible shortcuts
Progressive disclosure over information density at rest

rules.name: The Monochrome Doctrine
rules.body: The system has no brand accent color. Zinc carries every surface. If you reach for a saturated color, you're solving the wrong problem — use weight, size, or spacing instead.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: #3b82f6 exists for one purpose: keyboard focus rings. Never use it for decoration, status, or emphasis.

rules.name: The Mono-Only-When-Technical Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono appears only for keyboard shortcuts (Kbd), code, and technical identifiers. Never for body text or labels that aren't machine-readable.

rules.name: The No-Flat-Scale Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy requires at least a 1.25 ratio between steps. If two text sizes feel too close, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state (hover, focus, modal overlay). If a shadow exists on a resting card, it's too dark.

rules.name: The Border-Over-Shadow Rule
rules.body: When in doubt about separating surfaces, use a border. Borders are precise and predictable; shadows are ambient and subjective.

dos: Do use the zinc monochrome palette for all surfaces. Let lightness steps carry hierarchy, not hue.
Do separate surfaces with 1px borders at 60% opacity. Borders are precise; shadows are not.
Do use Geist for all UI text and Geist Mono only for keyboard shortcuts, code, and technical identifiers.
Do cap body text line length at 65-75ch for readability.
Do make focus rings visible and consistent. The single blue (#3b82f6) is reserved for this purpose.
Do use progressive disclosure. Show the essential data first, let users drill deeper.
Do use @opencited/ui components instead of raw HTML elements. Consistency is non-negotiable.
donts: Don't add a saturated accent color. The monochrome palette is the brand. If you reach for color, use weight, size, or spacing instead.
Don't use decorative gradients. No gradient text, no gradient backgrounds, no gradient borders.
Don't build busy dashboards with charts everywhere. Progressive disclosure over wall-of-metrics.
Don't use generic blue/gradient AI tool aesthetics. This is not a SaaS landing page template.
Don't use enterprise-y data visualizations. The interface should feel like a workspace, not a BI tool.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on cards or list items.
Don't use glassmorphism or backdrop-filter as a default treatment. Flat surfaces, clear borders.
Don't animate CSS layout properties. Use opacity, transform, or purposeful transitions only.
Don't use bounce or elastic easing. Ease out with exponential curves (ease-out-quart or better).
Don't wrap everything in a container. Most surfaces don't need one.
Don't use modals as a first thought. Exhaust inline and progressive alternatives first.
